label: membrane insertase activity
rationale: Mim1 is the catalytic/central subunit of the MIM insertase; Mim1 overexpression stimulates import, mim1 mitochondria fail to insert alpha-helical OMM proteins, and unrelated insertases (pATOM36, MTCH1) substitute functionally
curator_note: Not affected by this hypothesis. The client-rule analysis neither strengthens nor weakens this term.

label: MIM complex
rationale: Mim1 and Mim2 physically and genetically interact and form the MIM complex; the term's definition names Mim1

rationale: Covers both multispan and single-span alpha-helical clients, which is what the primary literature supports; GO:0045040 is broader and includes beta-barrel import
curator_note: Preferred BP. Verify the term is live in the current GO release before use.

rationale: Mim1 is an integral OMM protein
